in_english.name: Hank
in_english.meaning: Hank is a short form of common English names such as Henry or Hanck. Henry comes from the Germanic 'Haimrich,' meaning 'home ruler,' and Hanck is a variant of the Dutch name 'Hans,' meaning 'John' in Germanic languages. Both Henry and Hanck have roots in Old English and Old High German, and they share a common etymology with the biblical name 'Hannah,' meaning 'grace.'
